warnings.label: Upper River Derwent, Stonethwaite Beck and Derwent Water
warnings.description: Upper River Derwent, Stonethwaite Beck and Derwent Water
warnings.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding.
Weather conditions are expected to improve and no further flooding is expected. We are forecasting that the lake levels will continue to drop over the next couple of days.
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.

warnings.label: Hunstanton coast in Norfolk
warnings.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain.
The previous tide of concern has now passed,  the weather is more settled and no flooding is expected.  
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.

warnings.label: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
warnings.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
warnings.message:
Higher than normal tides this afternoon may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible 1:00pm to 4:00pm on Monday 12th October.
We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.  
This message will be updated by 5:00PM on Monday 12 October or as the situation changes.
